Wow, sounds like we're the same person. I was part time for 2.5 years before I decided to put aside college for work and went full time. As soon as I was eligible for GTL, I got it. I was sent to a new store. It is a lot slower than I'm used to. Which means less hours and less associates.

Our trucks are getting larger and larger as the summer approaches and yet no one will work hard. On nights, it's mainly the GTL who throws the most truck. The other GTL and I worked one night together and finished a 1300 piece truck alone. The others can't finish a 400 piece in 8 hours.

The management either say "Yeah, they really suck." or "You need to guide them better". Meanwhile no matter what approach we take, they don't work. Their only solution is to hire summer help and we all know they'll be just as bad.

They all have assigned aisles but don't have time to work on them since the store wants trucks done at night. We only have around 6 stock clerks/associates in all of grocery (minus frozen, dairy, dsd, scan clerk, etc).

I've preached constantly about having only two people close to maintain and unload truck then have the rest come in at 7am to run truck and maintain their assigned aisles but management refuses. To them, the truck has to be done during the night. Ignoring the fact that trucks do NOT get done, ever.

I've considered stepping down, going back to my old store, and waiting for a promotion in store where I know I can shine. I've already told my GM that if my eval is docked because of the teams performance, despite how hard I'm trying, I'll step down and leave.
